offer.text: I'm posted too far out to leave my watch, but the village must hear what I've seen. Make for the village and carry word back for me — quick as you can.

accept.text: Good. Keep to cover and don't stop running.

decline.text: Then the message waits, and so does the danger.

in_progress.text: Are you at the village yet? They need to know.

ready.text: Word delivered? Then we've a chance to be ready.

complete.text: Fast and faithful. The watch could use a runner like you.
